Container.Name: Meelo
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Music Server. Focused on metadata integration & UI

Config.Name: Public Url
Config.Description: External Url used to reach the instance

Config.Name: Music Root Folder
Config.Description: The directory where your music libraries live

Config.Name: Database folder
Config.Description: Directory where the database data will be stored

Config.Name: Message Queue folder
Config.Description: Directory where the message queue data will be stored

Config.Name: Meilisearch folder
Config.Description: Directory where the search engine data will be stored

Config.Name: Meilisearch Master Key
Config.Description: String of random characters (used to internally authenticate to Meilisearch)

Config.Name: JWT Signature
Config.Description: String of random characters (used to sign JSON Web Tokens)

Config.Name: Internal API Keys
Config.Description: Coma-separated strings of crandom characters (used for services to authenticate internally)

Config.Name: Postgres Username
Config.Description: Username to authenticate to the database

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: Password to authenticate to the database

Config.Name: Message Queue Username
Config.Description: Username to authenticate to the message queue

Config.Name: Message Queue Password
Config.Description: Password to authenticate to the message queue

Config.Name: LastFM API Key
Config.Description: API Key for scrobbling with LastFM

Config.Name: LastFM API Secret
Config.Description: API Secret for scrobbling with LastFM
